example.en: The facility director addressed employee concerns regarding improved ventilation in the workshop.
example.zh: 廠房主管回應了員工對於改善車間通風情況的關切。

words.mnemonic: 多益書信開頭常用：To Whom It May Concern (敬啟者)。

example.en: Failure to meet market demand could cause the company to lose valuable market share to rivals.
example.zh: 無法滿足市場需求可能會導致公司將寶貴的市場份額拱手讓給競爭對手。

words.mnemonic: 虧損與流失搭配：lose money (賠錢)、lose market share (失去市占率)。

example.en: The public relations team crafted an inspiring success story highlighting our client partnership.
example.zh: 公關團隊精心打造了一篇鼓舞人心的成功案例故事，突顯我們與客戶的合作夥伴關係。

words.mnemonic: 公關行銷常用 success story (成功故事)；亦可指建築樓層 (ten-story building)。

example.en: The engineering team has almost completed the functional testing phase of the new machine.
example.zh: 工程團隊已經差不多完成了新機器的功能測試階段。

words.mnemonic: 進度接近完成用語：almost finished (快完成了)、almost never (幾乎從不)。

example.en: Corporate sales are expected to continue their strong upward trend throughout the coming quarter.
example.zh: 預計在即將到來的季度中，企業銷售額將繼續保持強勁的上升趨勢。

words.mnemonic: 趨勢與合約延續動詞：continue to grow (持續成長)。
roots: tin 握住 → 連在一起持續

example.en: Company sales representatives will be stationed at our exhibition stand during the trade fair.
example.zh: 在貿易博覽會期間，公司業務代表將進駐我們的展覽攤位。

words.mnemonic: 展覽攤位名詞：exhibition stand；縮寫代表 stand for。

example.en: The chief executive commended the whole marketing team for their outstanding annual performance.
example.zh: 執行長讚揚了整個行銷團隊在年度的卓越表現。

words.mnemonic: 強調全員或完整期間：the whole team (整個團隊)、on the whole (整體而言)。

example.en: The final budget proposal has not yet been approved by the corporate finance committee.
example.zh: 最終預算提案尚未獲得企業財務委員會的核准。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：not yet (尚未)，搭配完成式；as yet (迄今)。

example.en: Corporate clients can secure preferential room rates by booking through our travel desk.
example.zh: 企業客戶透過我們的差旅服務台預訂，可鎖定優惠客房費率。

words.mnemonic: 旅館與金融超核心名詞：room rate (房價)、interest rate (利率)。

example.en: Our customer care center is committed to addressing every client complaint professionally.
example.zh: 我們的客戶關懷中心致力於專業地處理每一項客戶投訴。

words.mnemonic: 福利與服務考點：customer care (客戶關懷/客服)、health care (醫療保健)。

example.en: Financial analysts expect company profits to increase substantially over the coming fiscal year.
example.zh: 財務分析師預期公司利潤將在即將到來的會計年度大幅成長。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻句型：expect to do / expect someone to do (預期...做...)。
roots: spect 看 → 向外看、期待

example.en: The revised parking regulations will take effect starting on the first day of next month.
example.zh: 修訂後的停車管理辦法將自下個月第一天起正式生效。

words.mnemonic: 政策生效必背片語：take effect (生效)、have an effect on (對...產生影響)。
roots: fect 做 → 做出的結果

example.en: Automated sorting machines sort incoming courier packages by postal destination code.
example.zh: 自動分揀機依據郵遞目的地代碼對進廠快遞包裹進行分類。

words.mnemonic: 物流與郵務常考動作：sort packages (將包裹分類)。

example.en: This quarter recorded the highest customer satisfaction score we have ever achieved.
example.zh: 本季度創下了我們歷來所取得的最高客戶滿意度評分。

words.mnemonic: 最高級強調用語：the best... ever (史上最佳)。

example.en: Please let the support desk know if there is anything else we can do to assist you.
example.zh: 若有任何其他我們能為您提供協助的事項，請告知支援服務台。

words.mnemonic: 客服客氣詢問結尾句：Is there anything else I can help you with?

example.en: A power surge in the electrical grid caused a temporary shutdown of the assembly line.
example.zh: 電網中的電湧導致了組裝線的暫時停工。

words.mnemonic: 故障原因分析核心詞：cause a delay (導致延遲)。

example.en: Raw material costs are projected to fall by five percent over the upcoming autumn quarter.
example.zh: 預計在即將到來的秋季，原料成本將下降百分之五。

words.mnemonic: 指標下降動詞：prices fall (價格下跌)；亦可指秋季 (in the fall)。

example.en: Our purchasing director succeeded in closing a major supply deal with the overseas manufacturer.
example.zh: 我們的採購總監成功與海外製造商敲定了一筆重大供應協議。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重必考點：deal with (應對處理)、close a deal (達成交易)。

example.en: Complimentary bottled water and fresh fruit are provided in all guest rooms daily.
example.zh: 所有客房每天均提供免費瓶裝礦泉水與新鮮水果。

words.mnemonic: 飯店設施與辦公設備：bottled water (瓶裝水)、water cooler (飲水機)。

example.en: The billing clerk will send the updated commercial invoice to your accounting office today.
example.zh: 出納人員今天會將更新後的商業發票發送至您的會計室。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信與出貨核心動詞：send an email (寄信)、send an invoice (寄發票)。

example.en: The corporate policy allows full-time employees to take two days of personal leave each quarter.
example.zh: 企業政策允許全職員工每季享有兩天事假。

words.mnemonic: 規章政策句型：allow someone to do something (准許某人做某事)。

example.en: A customer service specialist will contact you as soon as your account inquiry is processed.
example.zh: 一旦您的帳戶洽詢處理完畢，客服專員將儘快與您聯絡。

words.mnemonic: 承諾回覆時間常用片語：as soon as possible (儘速)、coming soon (即將推出)。

example.en: All newly hired factory workers are required to watch an introductory workplace safety video.
example.zh: 所有新進工廠員工皆必須觀看一段職場安全簡介影片。

words.mnemonic: 在職訓練常用動詞：watch a video (觀看影片)；片語 watch out (小心)。

example.en: Annual sales commissions are calculated based on overall target revenue achievements.
example.zh: 年度業務佣金係根據整體目標營收達成率計算。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀必考分詞片語：based on (根據/以...為基礎)。

example.en: The product launch conference will probably be scheduled for the third week of September.
example.zh: 新產品發布會很可能會排定在九月的第三週舉行。

words.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 3/4 討論不確定行程常用的猜測副詞。

example.en: The corporate consultant suggested that the firm streamline its logistics fulfillment operations.
example.zh: 企業顧問建議該公司應精簡其物流履約作業。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 題幹最愛問：What does the speaker suggest?
roots: gest 攜帶 → 從下提出

example.en: Corporate sales revenue has grown steadily over the past three fiscal quarters.
example.zh: 在過去的三個會計季度中，企業銷售額穩定成長。

words.mnemonic: 完成式關鍵時間介系詞片語：over the past three years (在過去三年中)。

example.en: A severe thunderstorm caused a sudden power outage that temporarily halted factory operations.
example.zh: 一場嚴重的雷陣雨導致突發停電，工廠作業因此暫時停擺。

words.mnemonic: 設備與能源重點詞彙：power outage (停電)、power plant (發電廠)。

example.en: Quality assurance technicians test each electronic component thoroughly before shipping.
example.zh: 品保技術人員在出貨前均會對每個電子組件進行徹底測試。

words.mnemonic: 產品品管必備動作：test products (測試產品)、field test (現場測試)。

example.en: Customers are warmly invited to visit our official company website for more promotional details.
example.zh: 熱烈歡迎顧客造訪我們的官方公司網站以獲取更多促銷優惠詳情。

words.mnemonic: 宣傳與差旅常用動詞：visit our website (造訪我們的網站)。

example.en: The annual international software exhibition will take place at the city convention center.
example.zh: 年度國際軟體展覽會將在市立會展中心舉行。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻複合名詞：convention center (會展中心)、call center (電話客服中心)。

example.en: Our digital marketing initiative helped the company grow its international customer base significantly.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷計畫幫助公司顯著擴大了其國際客戶群。

words.mnemonic: 業績成長動詞：grow sales (提升銷售額)、grow rapidly (快速成長)。

example.en: The technician confirmed that there was nothing mechanically wrong with the office photocopier.
example.zh: 技術員確認辦公室影印機在機械結構上並無任何故障。

words.mnemonic: 排除故障時常用：nothing wrong (沒有問題/運作正常)。

example.en: Customers may return unworn apparel items within thirty days for a full credit refund.
example.zh: 顧客可在三十天內退還未穿戴的服飾商品以獲全額退款。

words.mnemonic: 退換貨政策核心詞：return policy (退貨政策)、return on investment (投資報酬率/ROI)。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits package includes paid leave for any working mother after childbirth.
example.zh: 該企業的員工福利套裝方案為產後職場職業婦女提供帶薪產假。

words.mnemonic: 員工育嬰福利：maternity leave (產假)、working mother (職業母親)。

example.en: The boutique downtown hotel is just a five-minute walk from the central subway station.
example.zh: 這家市中心精品飯店距離中央捷運站僅需步行五分鐘。

words.mnemonic: 飯店地理位置極高頻句型：a five-minute walk from (距...步行五分鐘)。

example.en: The executive director called an urgent meeting to resolve a confidential legal matter.
example.zh: 執行董事召開了一次緊急會議以解決一項機密的法律事項。

words.mnemonic: 商務公文常用片語：as a matter of fact (事實上)、legal matter (法律事項)。

example.en: Please keep in mind that office supply expense reports must be submitted before Friday.
example.zh: 請牢記在心，辦公文具費用報銷單必須在週五前繳交。

words.mnemonic: 多益必背片語：keep in mind (銘記在心)、Would you mind doing (您介意...嗎)。

example.en: We are proud to offer our commercial clients exceptional value and professional support.
example.zh: 我們非常自豪能為我們的企業客戶提供卓越的價值與專業的支援服務。

words.mnemonic: 商業評價核心詞：good value for money (物超所值)、market value (市場價值)。

example.en: Employees must scan their security identification badges before entering the corporate office.
example.zh: 員工在進入企業辦公室前必須先感應其安全識別證。

words.mnemonic: 多益最高頻場景：office supplies (辦公用品)、head office (總公司)。

example.en: The corporate position requires a high level of proficiency in international commercial law.
example.zh: 該企業職位要求具備高水準的國際商務法專業能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場能力要求標準搭配：entry level (初階/社會新鮮人職位)、high level (高階)。

example.en: Clients who prefer to discuss their loan applications in person are welcome to visit our branch.
example.zh: 偏好親自洽談貸款申請的客戶，竭誠歡迎蒞臨我們的分行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：in person (親自/本人親臨)。

example.en: The prospective candidate possesses extensive experience in supply chain optimization.
example.zh: 該準應徵者在供應鏈最佳化方面具備豐富的實務經驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 履歷要求核心字：relevant experience (相關經驗)、work experience (工作經驗)。

example.en: Once payment authorization is received, the warehouse will dispatch your order immediately.
example.zh: 一旦收到付款授權確認，倉庫將立即發送您的訂單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 條件連接詞極高頻：once + 主詞 + 動詞 (一旦...就...)。

example.en: Rewards program members receive exclusive access to our seasonal product pre-orders.
example.zh: 紅利積點會員可享有我們季節性新品預購的專屬禮遇。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 團隊與會員制詞彙：team member (團隊成員)、staff member (員工)。

example.en: The purchasing manager ensured that we have enough inventory to fulfill peak season orders.
example.zh: 採購經理確保我們備有充裕的庫存以應付旺季的訂單需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 庫存與資源必考形容詞：enough time (充裕的時間)、enough inventory (足夠庫存)。

example.en: The ferry service across the harbor was suspended due to unusually bad weather conditions.
example.zh: 由於異常惡劣的天候狀況，跨港渡輪服務暫停行駛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 天候與服務故障常用詞：bad weather (壞天氣)、bad condition (狀況不佳)。

example.en: The express train provides direct transportation between the international airport and city center.
example.zh: 這班快捷特快車在國際機場與市中心之間提供直達接駁交通。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通地理位置常用詞：city center (市中心)、city hall (市政府)。

example.en: The special corporate travel package covers three nights in a deluxe executive room.
example.zh: 這套專案企業差旅套票涵蓋在豪華商務客房連續住宿三晚。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店訂房與快遞出貨必備：per night (每晚)、overnight delivery (隔夜送達)。

example.en: With the updated software system, staff will be able to process customer invoices in seconds.
example.zh: 透過升級後的軟體系統，員工將能夠在數秒內處理完客戶發票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益能力表達最核心片語：be able to + 原形動詞 (能夠做某事)。

example.en: Our dedicated technical support team is available twenty-four hours a day to assist registered clients.
example.zh: 我們的專職技術支援團隊全天候二十四小時提供協助，隨時服務註冊客戶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服中心核心招牌：technical support (技術支援)、customer support (客戶支援)。
roots: port 攜帶 → 從下撐住

example.en: The electronics manufacturer introduced an entirely new product line of smart home sensors.
example.zh: 這家電子製造商推出了一個全新系列的智慧家庭感測器產品線。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工廠製造與行銷高頻詞：production line (生產線)、product line (產品線)。

example.en: The research team will present their latest quarterly findings at the global summit tomorrow.
example.zh: 研究團隊將於明天的全球高峰會上發表他們最新的季度調查成果。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 動詞 /prɪˈzɛnt/ (發表簡報)；形容詞 /ˈprɛznt/ (出席在場的)。
roots: sent 在 (esse) → 在面前、呈現

example.en: Both sides in the contract dispute reached an amicable agreement without entering litigation.
example.zh: 合約爭議的雙方在未進入訴訟程序的情況下達成了和解協議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務談判協議用語：both sides (雙方)、on the other hand (在另一方面)。

example.en: The newly remodeled conference hall is quite spacious and can accommodate up to three hundred people.
example.zh: 全新改裝的會議廳相當寬敞，最多可容納三百人。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 程度修飾副詞：quite a few (相當多個)、quite good (相當不錯)。

example.en: Although production expenses rose slightly, net company profits remained remarkably steady.
example.zh: 雖然生產費用略有上升，但公司的淨利潤仍保持得相當穩定。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀長篇轉折連接詞，引導讓步子句。

example.en: Please make sure that all office computers are properly shut down before the holiday weekend.
example.zh: 在連續假期週末前，請務必確認所有辦公室電腦皆已妥善關機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室指令極高頻片語：make sure (確保/務必)。

example.en: Both legal teams spent several days negotiating the final payment terms of the acquisition agreement.
example.zh: 雙方法務團隊花了數天時間協商收購協議的最終付款條款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益合約與策略大考點：terms and conditions (合約條款)、long-term (長期)。

example.en: All employees should submit their annual leave requests at least two weeks before their departure date.
example.zh: 所有員工應在出發日期至少兩週前提出特休假申請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 規定期限極高頻片語：at least (至少)。

example.en: Company hiring policy strictly enforces equal employment opportunities regardless of gender or age.
example.zh: 公司招募政策嚴格落實平等就業機會，不論性別或年齡皆一視同仁。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 就業防歧視政策常考詞：regardless of age (不論年齡)。

example.en: Our online travel agency provides exceptionally low prices on domestic airline tickets.
example.zh: 我們的線上旅行社提供極為低廉的國內機票價格。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 促銷文案高頻詞：low price (低價)、low cost (低成本)。

example.en: A prominent industry keynote speaker was invited to speak about emerging artificial intelligence trends.
example.zh: 一位知名產業特邀演講嘉賓受邀針對新興人工智慧趨勢發表演說。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 演說動詞；電話英語常用：May I speak to Mr. White?

example.en: Customer support guarantees that all email inquiries will be answered within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 客戶服務承諾所有電子郵件諮詢皆將在二十四小時內獲得回覆。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時效限制介系詞大考點：within 24 hours (二十四小時內)。

example.en: The application process takes a week.
example.zh: 申請流程需要一週時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: process an application。
roots: cess 走 → 前進的過程

example.en: The convention center is conveniently situated near multiple accessible public transportation links.
example.zh: 會展中心地理位置優越，鄰近多條便利的大眾交通接駁網絡。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公共公關考點：public transportation (大眾運輸)、public relations (公關/PR)。

example.en: Corporate sales representatives often travel across the state to meet prospective commercial clients.
example.zh: 企業業務代表經常出差走訪全州以拜訪潛在商業客戶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 頻率副詞常客，出現在日常辦公作息描寫。

example.en: Our senior supervisors will train newly recruited staff members on automated software tools.
example.zh: 我們的資深主管將針對自動化軟體工具培訓新進員工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資動詞培訓；交通名詞火車：take a train (搭火車)。

example.en: Please complete and submit your quarterly sales forecast report as soon as possible.
example.zh: 請盡速填寫並呈繳您的季度銷售預測報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信最通用片語：as soon as possible (ASAP, 盡快)。

example.en: The final renovation costs were actually lower than our original architectural estimate.
example.zh: 最終的裝修費用實際上低於我們原先的建築估算。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 3/4 修正對方觀點時常用副詞。

example.en: Management decided to upgrade the existing facility rather than construct an entirely new warehouse.
example.zh: 管理層決定升級現有設施，而不是興建一座全新的倉庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益必考二選一偏好句型：rather than (而不是)。

example.en: Guests staying in the deluxe corner suite enjoy a breathtaking panoramic view of the harbor.
example.zh: 入住豪華邊間套房的旅客可飽覽海港令人屏息的全景風光。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店訂房核心賣點：ocean view (海景)；觀點 point of view。

example.en: Engineering and marketing divisions worked together to ensure the successful rollout of the device.
example.zh: 工程與行銷部門通力合作，以確保該裝置成功推向市場。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 團隊合作核心詞：work together (合作)、put together (組合/組建)。

example.en: The hiring committee will carefully consider all candidate credentials before scheduling interviews.
example.zh: 招募委員會將在安排面試前仔細考慮所有候選人的資歷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 決策常用動詞，後接名詞或 V-ing：consider doing something。

example.en: Guests are strongly advised to keep personal valuables inside their hotel room safe.
example.zh: 強烈建議房客將個人貴重物品妥善存放於飯店客房保險箱內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 形容詞指安全的，名詞指「客房保險箱」(in-room safe)。

example.en: We cordially invite all regional business partners to attend our annual product showcase.
example.zh: 我們誠摯地邀請所有區域商業夥伴出席我們的年度產品發表會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞 invitation (邀請函)，多益商務社交極常見動詞。

example.en: Our strategic marketing mix includes targeted digital advertising and sponsored industry events.
example.zh: 我們的行銷組合策略涵蓋了精準數位廣告投放與贊助行業盛會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷核心名詞搭配：marketing mix (行銷組合)、product mix (產品線組合)。

example.en: Clear accountability is an essential element of modern corporate governance standards.
example.zh: 清晰的權責劃分是現代企業治理標準不可或缺的核心要素。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 重要構成要素：key element (關鍵要素)、essential element (不可或缺的要素)。

example.en: Please ensure that your billing address details are entirely correct before checkout.
example.zh: 結帳之前請務必確認您的帳單地址資料完全正確無誤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: cor- (共同、完全) + rect (正、直) ＝ 完全端正 ＝ 正確的。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits package includes full comprehensive medical and dental insurance.
example.zh: 該企業員工福利方案涵蓋了全面的醫療與牙科保險保障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 福利制度考點：medical insurance (醫療保險)、medical leave (病假)。

example.en: Only pre-registered trade attendees will be admitted to the exhibition hall today.
example.zh: 今天只有事先完成報名的商務人士方能獲准進入展覽大廳。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + mit (送、放行) ＝ 放行進入或承認。

example.en: Our discount airfare policy promises to beat any competitor price by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們的折扣機票保證比任何競爭對手的價格再優惠百分之十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業競爭常見：beat the competition (擊敗競爭對手)、beat the deadline (趕在期限前)。

example.en: The client requested a follow-up telephone consultation to review the proposal terms.
example.zh: 客戶要求安排後續電話諮詢，以審視企劃書各項條款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: tele- (遠距離) + phone (聲音) ＝ 電話溝通。

example.en: Please print a hard copy of the final audit report for today's executive review.
example.zh: 請為今天的主管審核會議列印一份最終審計報告的紙本副本。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室必備：hard copy (紙本列印)、make a copy (影印)。

example.en: Handling such sensitive financial data requires strict compliance with privacy standards.
example.zh: 處理如此敏感的財務資料必須嚴格遵守隱私權標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀舉例與定義極高頻片語：such as (諸如、例如)。

example.en: According to the financial report, company sales increased by eight percent last month.
example.zh: 根據財務報告，公司銷售額上個月增長了百分之八。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 過去時間指標詞：last month (上個月)、last year (去年)；動詞意為持續。

example.en: The resort hotel offers dedicated supervision activities for guests traveling with a child.
example.zh: 該度假飯店為帶兒童出遊的旅客提供專門的託兒照料活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店服務與員工福利常見詞：child care (托兒服務)。

example.en: The supervisor will tell the team about the upcoming revisions to the project timeline.
example.zh: 主管將向團隊說明專案時程即將做出的修訂。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務通訊句型：tell someone about something (告訴某人某事)。

example.en: We really appreciate your patience while our technical team resolves the server issue.
example.zh: 在我們的技術團隊排查伺服器問題時，我們非常感謝您的耐心等候。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益書信常用客氣加強詞：really appreciate (非常感謝)。

example.en: The committee chairman decided to call an emergency meeting to review the tender bid.
example.zh: 委員會主席決定召開緊急會議以審查投標文件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻商業搭配：call a meeting (召開會議)、conference call (電話會議)。

example.en: All employees should submit their completed reimbursement forms before the end of the month.
example.zh: 所有員工應在月底之前提交填寫完畢的報帳請款單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 截止期限關鍵時間詞：before the deadline (在截止日期之前)。

example.en: Our company has grown from a local enterprise into an international manufacturer.
example.zh: 我們公司已從一家在地企業成長為國際製造商。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最核心主體：company policy (公司政策)、parent company (母公司)。

example.en: The corporate convention center is conveniently situated directly opposite the main metro station.
example.zh: 這座商務會議展覽中心位置便利，就正正座落於中央捷運火車站的斜對面。

reviewWords.mnemonic: op- (相反、朝向) + posit (放置) ＝ 放在正對面的 ＝ directly opposite (正對面)。

example.en: Achieving profitability this fiscal quarter represents a major milestone for our software startup.
example.zh: 在本會計季度實現轉虧為盈，對我們的軟體新創公司而言是一座重大的里程碑。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 專案進度管理核心字彙：milestone (專案里程碑重要階段)。

example.en: The company invested a substantial sum of money into developing autonomous delivery vehicle prototypes.
example.zh: 該公司投入了一筆可觀的巨額資金，用於研發自動駕駛物流車的原型車輛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財務必備：lump sum (一次性整筆支付金額)、sum up (總結會議要點)。

example.en: Rush-hour highway traffic during the evening downtown commute can be absolute murder.
example.zh: 在晚間市中心通勤的交通尖峰時段，高速公路塞車簡直讓人痛苦難耐折騰萬分。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力日常誇飾用語：Rush-hour traffic is murder (尖峰塞車簡直是折磨)。

meaning: 電腦螢幕/監控儀器(名詞)

example.en: Quality control software engineers continuously monitor server performance to prevent outages.
example.zh: 品管軟體工程師隨時持續監控伺服器主機效能，以防止系統意外當機停擺。

reviewWords.mnemonic: monit- (警告、提醒) + -or ＝ 提醒注意狀態的人或儀器 ＝ 監視、電腦螢幕。

example.en: Despite severe logistical disruptions, the warehouse distribution team decided to soldier on.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的物流配送中斷阻礙，倉儲發貨團隊依然決定堅定奮戰克服困難。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業職場勵志片語：soldier on (不屈不撓堅定奮戰前行)。

example.en: The corporate commercial bank agreed to finance the construction of the new production plant.
example.zh: 該企業商業銀行同意為這座全新工廠的興建工程提供融資借貸資金支援。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心：finance department (財務部)、financial statement (財務報表)。

example.en: I hate to bother you during your annual leave, but we urgently need your client file password.
example.zh: 我實在很不願意在您的年休假期期間打擾您，但我們緊急需要您負責的客戶檔案密碼。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場客套委婉用語：I hate to bother you, but... (很過意不去打擾您，但是...)。

example.en: Analysts predict that sales will rise next quarter.
example.zh: 分析師預測下一季銷售額將上升。

reviewWords.mnemonic: pre-（預先）+ dict（說）＝事先說出來。

example.en: The new system is more efficient.
example.zh: 電子公文系統是管理日常行政作業非常高效的方式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 少花時間或資源。

example.en: Staff distributed the forms to visitors.
example.zh: 會議開始前，秘書向所有與會代表分發了議程表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 把東西分給多人。
roots: tribut 給予 → 分給大家

example.en: The museum will exhibit local artwork.
example.zh: 我們公司將在下週的科技展覽會上展出新款機器人。

reviewWords.mnemonic: exhibit artwork。
roots: hibit 握住 → 拿出來展示

example.en: Since the senior project manager was out of the office, her deputy led the client consultation.
example.zh: 由於資深專案經理不在辦公室，由她的代理人主持客戶諮詢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考法：表時間「自從」（搭配現在完成式）或表原因「既然/因為」。

example.en: Our marketing division plans to run a promotional campaign on popular social media platforms.
example.zh: 我們的行銷部門計劃在熱門社群媒體平台上推行一場宣傳促銷活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益常考「經營管理/執行活動」：run a business (做生意), run a campaign。

example.en: The historical office complex is currently under renovation to improve accessibility for all visitors.
example.zh: 這座歷史悠久的辦公園區目前正在整修中，以提升所有訪客的無障礙便利性。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益超高頻片語結構：under construction (施工中)、under warranty (在保固期內)。

example.en: Employees must remember to turn off all air conditioning units and office lights before leaving.
example.zh: 員工在離開辦公室前務必記得關閉所有冷氣機與辦公室照明。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 關閉與繳交設備動詞片語：turn off (關閉電源)、turn in (呈繳報告)。

example.en: Only a few tickets remain available for the annual charity banquet this weekend.
example.zh: 本週末舉行的年度慈善晚宴目前僅剩為數不多的票券可供購買。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾可數複數名詞：a few (少數幾個/一些)；few (幾乎沒有)。

example.en: All workshop attendees should bring their employee identification badges to access the building.
example.zh: 所有工作坊與會者皆應攜帶其員工識別證以進入大樓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務會談常客：bring about (促成)、bring up (在會議中提出討論)。

example.en: Passengers who take advantage of our early booking discount can save up to thirty percent.
example.zh: 善用我們早鳥預訂優惠的旅客最多可節省百分之三十的費用。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益促銷經典用法：early bird discount (早鳥優惠)。

example.en: Please hand in your finalized expense reimbursement forms to the accounting department by noon.
example.zh: 請於中午前將填寫完畢的差旅報銷單交至會計部門。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室交公文必備片語：hand in (繳交)、hand out (發放講義)。

example.en: The corporate contract clearly states that all cancellation requests must be submitted in writing.
example.zh: 企業合約中明確陳述所有取消申請皆必須以書面方式提出。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 正式文件陳述條款動詞；名詞 state of the art (最先進的技術)。

example.en: Our regional marketing headquarters will move to a newly constructed office park next month.
example.zh: 我們的區域行銷總部將於下個月搬遷至新建成的辦公園區。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室搬遷公告考點：move to a new location (搬遷至新址)。

example.en: We offer a thirty-day money-back guarantee if customers are not completely satisfied with the product.
example.zh: 若客戶對產品不甚滿意，我們提供三十天內無條件全額退費保證。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客戶退款保證標準詞彙：money-back guarantee (不滿意退費保證)。

example.en: The consultant presented verified facts and figures to support the corporate restructuring proposal.
example.zh: 顧問提出了經過查證的事實與數據，以支持企業組織重整的提案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議提案用片語：facts and figures (事實與數據)、in fact (事實上)。

example.en: We intended to dispatch the shipment today; however, severe weather forced a temporary delay.
example.zh: 我們原定今日發貨；然而，惡劣天候迫使出貨暫時延後。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀轉折語氣之王，標誌著條件受限或狀況生變。

example.en: Unauthorized personnel are strictly prohibited from entering the chemical storage area.
example.zh: 未經授權人員嚴禁進入化學品儲存區域。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工廠安全區域標誌：restricted area (管制區)、smoking area (吸菸區)。

example.en: Please print your full legal name clearly on the conference registration badge.
example.zh: 請在研討會報到識別證上清晰正楷填寫您的法定全名。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 填表必備欄位：full name (全名)；brand name (品牌名稱)。

example.en: Employees should carefully read the revised travel reimbursement policy before booking tickets.
example.zh: 員工在訂票前應仔細審閱修訂後的差旅費報銷規定。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 簽約或實施政策常客：read carefully (仔細閱讀)。

example.en: Our current staff referral program offers cash incentives when you recommend a friend for an open position.
example.zh: 我們的內部員工推薦計畫在您推薦朋友應徵職缺成功時提供現金獎勵。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業招募方案常用：refer a friend (推薦朋友求職)。

example.en: Utility invoices and office rental payments are due on the first day of each month.
example.zh: 水電費帳單與辦公室租金於每個月的第一天到期應付。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財務出帳周期：end of the month (月底)、last month (上個月)。

example.en: The newly opened regional distribution hub can store a large inventory of consumer electronics.
example.zh: 新啟用的區域經銷物流中心可存放大量的消費性電子產品庫存。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 描述規模常用：large quantity (大量)、at large (普遍地/整體而言)。

example.en: The regional sales manager will travel to London on business for three consecutive days.
example.zh: 區域銷售經理將前往倫敦連續出差三天處理公務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最重要的字首之一：on business (出差)、business hours (營業時間)。

example.en: Refunds cannot be issued for returned merchandise without an original store receipt.
example.zh: 退換商品若未檢附原始店家收據，恕無法辦理退款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 政策限制常見介系詞：without prior notice (恕不另行通知)。

example.en: For more detailed information regarding hotel amenities, please inquire at the front desk.
example.zh: 欲了解更多關於飯店休閒設施的詳細資訊，請向接待櫃檯洽詢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益不可數名詞大考點：for more information (如需更多資訊)。

example.en: Our downtown branch will officially open for business next Monday at eight-thirty.
example.zh: 我們的市中心分行將於下週一上午八點半正式開門營業。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 開店與職缺核心詞：open for business (營業)、job opening (職缺)。

example.en: Please include your confirmed order number when contacting customer service regarding delivery.
example.zh: 就配送問題與客戶服務部聯繫時，請隨附您的確認訂單編號。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業採購核心考點：place an order (下訂單)、out of order (故障)。

example.en: The engineering corporation won a lucrative contract to build government infrastructure facilities.
example.zh: 這家工程公司贏得了一項興建政府公共基礎設施的巨額標案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公家機關與投標常考：government regulation (政府規章)。

example.en: Positive word of mouth from satisfied customers helped our new product gain market traction quickly.
example.zh: 滿意顧客良好的口耳相傳，幫助我們的新產品迅速在市場上建立聲勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷高頻必考片語：word of mouth (口碑行銷)。

example.en: Please report any technical issue.
example.zh: 請回報任何技術問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: issue 可表示問題或發布。

example.en: Conducting thorough market research is crucial prior to launching products overseas.
example.zh: 在向海外推出產品之前，進行徹底的市場調查至關重要。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商管必背字：market share (市場占有率)、market research (市調)。
